mapper.select: SELECT poit.id FROM dmp_order_info poi LEFT JOIN dmp_order_item_split poit ON poi.id = poit.order_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND poit.sku_no = #{skuNo} AND poit.new_sign NOT IN (1) AND to_char(platform_create_time, 'yyyy') = #{year}

SELECT T."sku_no" AS skuNo, T."LatestPurchaseDate" AS costDate, ROUND(AVG(S."tax_price"),4) AS costPrice, CAST(T."LatestPurchaseDate" - INTERVAL '3 months' AS DATE) AS threeMonthsAgoDate, CAST(T."LatestPurchaseDate" AS DATE) AS latestPurchaseDate FROM ( SELECT "sku_no", MAX("purchase_date") AS "LatestPurchaseDate" FROM "Sheet1" GROUP BY "sku_no" ) AS T JOIN "Sheet1" S ON T."sku_no" = S."sku_no" AND S."purchase_date" >= T."LatestPurchaseDate" - INTERVAL '3 months' GROUP BY T."sku_no", T."LatestPurchaseDate";
SELECT order_id, item_id, platform_sku FROM dmp_order_item_split WHERE is_split_sku = 1 GROUP BY order_id, item_id, platform_sku
